title: 1、猫耳娘的早安喵
slug: 摇曳歌姬全本免费-摇曳歌姬最新章节列表
content_zh:
在她做出这个决定的那天，她清晨五点半就‘被’起床了。
低血压的她之所以能够做到这么困难的事情，是因为她喂养了一只可以叫人起床的早安喵。
“呜喵！呜喵！呜喵！”
身穿猫耳女仆装的母亲跪坐在床上，正在充当着闹钟的作用。
睡眼惺松的镜花努力睁大了眼睛，伸手按在了猫耳上。
如果这是普通的闹钟的话，此时早已经被有着严重起床气的镜花给丢出去了。
不过，考虑到这是猫耳女仆的话，镜花决定忍耐。
“都已经是三十多岁的老女人了，就算是卖萌也一点都不可爱哟！”
泉镜花揉了揉她那水灵灵的眼睛，艰难的从床上爬了起来。
而在这期间，床上那只三十多岁的早安喵正眼巴巴的看着镜花。
“奖励呢！奖励呢！”
泉镜花蹙了蹙眉，不禁感叹为什么在别人面前自己就能风平浪静，但是这个母亲却总是能够轻而易举的挑动自己的心绪。
为什么我会有这样一个母亲呢？为什么我会来到这个平行世界呢？为什么我会变成女孩子呢？
然而即使再怎么思考也无法得出答案，泉镜花只能无奈的勾了勾手指。
反应迅速，或者说早已经养成了条件反射的早安喵立刻捧出了一个笔记本。令泉镜花不由得在心中感叹，为什么你这么熟练啊！
“忠于职守，叫醒我一次，完成任务早安喵的呼唤，可以获得可乐半瓶，百奇巧克力棒半包。”
说着泉镜花忍不住看了一眼自己的母亲，虽然三十多岁了，但是时间仿佛在她身上失去了效用，无论是身体还是精神。看起来仿佛少女一般精致细嫩的面容，无论是身材还是皮肤都是绝佳，尤其是换上猫耳女仆装之后就像是完全融入了灵魂一般。
除了脑子不好以外堪称完美啊！
此时这只早安喵双眼通红，但脸上却露出兴奋的表情，喊道：“我有积攒的半瓶可乐，还有pocky，我要合成！”
“两个可乐半瓶，有一定几率合成一瓶，两个pocky半包，有一定几率合成一包。你确定要合成吗？”

“嗯嗯！”早安喵母亲疯狂的点着头，不愧是网游废人，通宵之后还记得完成任务，一听到合成就血脉膨胀。
还未从起床气的难受氛围中出来的泉镜花面无表情的开口：“叮！你的合成失败，两个可乐半瓶破碎了！”
“什么！”早安喵的脸上浮现出凄惨的表情，但一瞬之后她又充满期待的问道：“那pocky呢？”
“pocky也失败了，一起碎掉了。”泉镜花从床上爬起，伸手拿起了衣物随意的套着。
早安喵的脸上满是不容置信的表情，几乎都要哭出来了。片刻之后她嘟着嘴瘫软在镜花的床上，一脸委屈的向着镜花问道：“果然，我是非洲人对吧！”
泉镜花别过脸去，不去看她那泪眼朦脓的样子，淡淡说道：“人品不好，没有办法。”
这样对待自己的母亲是不是过分了点呢？泉镜花的心中稍微有了点内疚与歉意。
“叮，特别任务，完成任务的话将有可能获得pocky一包！”
提到百奇泉镜花稍微提高的语调，果然，看到原本低垂着头的早安喵露出了惊讶与幸福的表情。
“呜喵！竟然是一包！我还是第一次见到呢！原来pocky居然可以是一包的吗？”
“这可是特别任务，如果没有特别的奖励的话，怎么能够算得上是特别的任务呢！”泉镜花平静了声调，随后换成了郑重的语气：“我想要知道南香绫……”
一瞬间这只早安喵就钻进了被子之中，脸色苍白的从被子中钻出了一个头来，连猫耳都在颤抖起来。
“太可怕了，太可怕了。老妖婆太可怕了！”
镜花不禁一怔，问道：“不就是爸爸的前妻么，有那么可怕吗？你就把她当成大boss好了，那也应该有攻略方法的吧。”
“不可能的，老妖婆根本不是大boss，她根本就是bug，是世界的错！她的可怕程度，凌驾于香菜之上！”
“香菜啊。”镜花面色一僵，“那可真难搞定啊！”
随意的穿上外套，泉镜花下床洗漱。如果是一般的母亲的话肯定已经为女儿放好了水准备好了牙膏，不过镜花回头看了看自己的母亲，她已经冲到了电脑前继续玩游戏起来了。

content_en:
On the day she made this decision, she got up at half past five in the morning.
The reason she was able to do such a difficult thing despite her low blood pressure was because she fed a good morning cat that could wake people up.
"Meow! Meow! Meow!"
The mother, wearing a cat-eared maid outfit, was kneeling on the bed, acting as an alarm clock.
The sleepy Kyoka tried her best to open her eyes wide, and put her hand on the cat's ear.
If this was an ordinary alarm clock, it would have been thrown out by Kyoka who was very angry at getting out of bed.
However, considering that these were the words of the cat-eared maid, Kyoka decided to endure it.
"She is already an old woman in her thirties. Even if she tries to be cute, she is not cute at all!"
Quan Jinghua rubbed her watery eyes and climbed up from the bed with difficulty.
During this period, the thirty-year-old Good Morning Meow on the bed was looking longingly at Kyoka.
"There's a reward! There's a reward!"
Quan Jinghua frowned and couldn't help but lament why she could be calm in front of others, but this mother could always stir up her emotions easily.
Why do I have such a mother? Why did I come to this parallel world? Why did I become a girl?
However, no matter how much she thought about it, she couldn't come up with an answer. Quan Jinghua could only curl her fingers helplessly.
Good Morning Meow, who reacted quickly, or had already developed a conditioned reflex, immediately took out a notebook. Lingquan Jinghua couldn't help but sigh in her heart, why are you so skilled!
"Be loyal to your duties, wake me up once, complete the mission and call me good morning, and you can get half a bottle of Coke and half a pack of Pocky chocolate bars."
As Izumi Kyoka said, she couldn't help but glance at her mother. Although she was in her thirties, time seemed to have lost its effect on her, both physically and mentally. She looks like a girl with a delicate and delicate face, both body and skin are excellent, especially after putting on the cat-eared maid outfit, she seems to have completely integrated into her soul.
Except for the bad brain, it is perfect!
At this time, the Good Morning Cat's eyes were red, but his face showed an excited expression, and he shouted: "I have half a bottle of Coke that I have saved, and pocky, I want to synthesize it!"
"Two half-bottles of Coke have a certain chance of being combined into a bottle. Two half-packs of Pocky have a certain chance of being combined into a pack. Are you sure you want to combine them?"
"Yeah!" Good Morning Meow's mother nodded crazily. She was indeed a loser in online games. She still remembered to complete the task after staying up all night, and her blood swelled as soon as she heard the synthesis.
Izumi Jinghua, who had not yet come out of the uncomfortable atmosphere of getting out of bed, said expressionlessly: "Ding! Your synthesis failed, and the two half-bottles of Coke were broken!"
"What!" A miserable expression appeared on Good Morning Meow's face, but a moment later she asked expectantly: "What about Pocky?"
"Pocky also failed and was broken together." Quan Jinghua got up from the bed, reached out and picked up the clothes and put them on casually.
Good Morning Meow's face was full of disbelief, and he almost cried. After a moment, she slumped down on Jinghua's bed with her lips pouted, and asked Jinghua with an aggrieved face: "As expected, I am an African, right?"
Quan Jinghua turned away, not looking at her tearful eyes, and said calmly: "If you have a bad character, there is nothing you can do about it."
Is it too much to treat your mother like this? Quan Jinghua felt a little guilty and apologetic in her heart.
"Ding, special mission. If you complete the mission, you may get a pack of pocky!"
Speaking of Pocket Izumi Kyoka's slightly raised tone, sure enough, she saw the expression of surprise and happiness when she saw Good Morning Meow, who was originally lowering his head.
"Meow meow! It's actually a pack! This is the first time I've seen it! So pocky can actually come in a pack?"
"This is a special mission. If there is no special reward,If so, how can it be considered a special mission? "Izumi Jinghua calmed down her tone, and then changed to a solemn tone: "I want to know Nan Xiang Ling..."
In an instant, the good morning cat got into the quilt, and a head emerged from the quilt with a pale face, and even the cat ears were trembling.
“It’s terrible, it’s terrible. The old witch is so scary! "
Jinghua couldn't help but be startled and asked: "Isn't she her father's ex-wife? Is she that scary? If you just treat her as the big boss, then there should be ways to defeat her. "
"It's impossible. The old witch is not the boss at all. She is simply a bug and it is the world's fault! Her terrifying level is beyond that of coriander! "
“Cilantro. "Jinghua's face froze, "That's really difficult to handle! "
Putting on her coat casually, Quan Jinghua got out of bed and washed up. An ordinary mother would have put out water and prepared toothpaste for her daughter, but Kyoka looked back at her mother, who had already rushed to the computer and continued playing games.
